blocking.section: Decision drivers (Budget safety); Decision outcome table (Token Budget row)
blocking.issue: The ADR says the overshoot is bounded 'as pack 8.9 and the owning document's Settlement state', as if the two sources gave one bound. They give different bounds. The owning document adds a term for extra attempts and one for hidden reasoning, and keeps the extra-attempt term finite with a 2-attempt cap on budgeted Routes that stops Provider Fallback with `RZ-AI-005`. The Token Budget row leaves out that cap and the owning document's per-request settlement rule ('All of R once per request, plus usage other attempts reported'). An implementer who reads only the ADR's normative table gets a different settlement rule and no attempt cap.
blocking.evidence: ADR line 28: "with overshoot bounded as pack 8.9 and the owning document's [Settlement](...) state (hypothesis; SM-10)". Line 54: "`onLog` charges usage and releases the rest, or charges all of R and emits a degraded-state metric when usage is missing". Pack 8.9: "| Overshoot bound | At most the sum of input-estimate errors across concurrent requests (hypothesis; SM-10) |". Owning doc, Settlement: "plus (attempts - 1) x R per concurrent request ([Model routing](#model-routing); hypothesis), plus, while OQ-ai-llm-gateway-17 is open, hidden reasoning above C on `gemini` and `ollama`" and "| Attempt reached the provider, no usage read | ... | All of R once per request, plus usage other attempts reported |". Model routing: "Routes with `ai.token-budget` allow 2 attempts (target) and stop Provider Fallback with `RZ-AI-005` once the attempts' usage, counting R for an attempt without usage, reaches R."
blocking.fix: Budget safety: "... overshoot at most the sum of concurrent input-estimate errors plus (attempts - 1) x R per concurrent request and, while OQ-ai-llm-gateway-17 is open, hidden reasoning above C on `gemini` and `ollama` (hypothesis; SM-10), as [Settlement](../architecture/06-ai-llm-gateway.md#settlement) states; pack 8.9 omits the extra terms until OQ-ai-llm-gateway-15 closes." In the Token Budget row, replace the `onLog` clause with: "`onLog` charges usage summed over attempts, plus all of R once per request if an attempt lacked usage (degraded-state metric), and releases the rest; budgeted Routes allow 2 attempts (target) and stop Provider Fallback with `RZ-AI-005` once that charge reaches R".
